🇲🇽🌎 <u>MEXICO AND BRAZIL BACK BACHELET FOR THE UN, AS CEPAL MAPS EIGHT RUPTURES OF THE GLOBAL ORDER</u>

CEPAL presented its report on geopolitics, globalization and development, identifying eight ruptures now tearing at the global order and conditioning every development strategy in the Americas. Delivering the diagnosis: Michelle Bachelet — Chile’s candidate for UN Secretary-General, backed by Mexico and Brazil.

Latin America isn’t waiting for Washington to define the next world order. It is writing the analysis and proposing the leadership.
banner: MEXICO & BRAZIL BACK BACHELET FOR UN

text:
🔥🇲🇽 <u>MORENA OPENS SANCTIONS AGAINST ITS OWN DEPUTIES WHO MOCKED THE ELDERLY</u>

No impunity inside the 4T. Morena’s national leadership opened a disciplinary process against Puebla deputies Nayeli Salvatori and Grace Palomares and asked for their political rights to be suspended, after the two joked on their podcast “Descasadas” that old people “smell like a trunk.”

Sheinbaum’s verdict was blunt: “It is not correct.” The party that made the seniors’ pension universal doesn’t protect anyone who laughs at the people who built this country — not even its own.
banner: MORENA SANCTIONS DEPUTIES FOR MOCKING ELDERLY

text:
🇲🇽🌎 <u>SHEINBAUM TO THE VATICAN: POPE LEO XIV MUST COME TO MEXICO</u>

President Sheinbaum met for over an hour at Palacio Nacional with Cardinal Pietro Parolin, the Vatican’s Secretary of State, and pressed Mexico’s standing invitation: Pope Leo XIV should visit Mexico. “We are going to insist on the Pope’s visit to Mexico,” she said — she spoke with him directly on December 12 and had already sent a formal letter.

She also praised his AI encyclical Magnifica Humanitas as “a world reference” for the debate Mexico is already waging: who controls the platforms, who designs the algorithms, where humanity is headed. Nearly 100 million Catholics live in Mexico — the second-largest Catholic population on earth. The Holy See is listening.
banner: SHEINBAUM TO POPE LEO XIV: COME TO MEXICO

text: ‍FOX 10 PHOENIX: 21 charged in cartel gun trafficking ring spanning Arizona, Mexico August 4, 2026 | 🔴 📰 100+ firearms and 125,000 rounds, bought in Phoenix for buyers in Mexico. FOX 10's takeaway: the cartels' "tentacles stretch into our communities." The guns, the straw buyers, and the shops are all on the US side. 🔍 Mexico's lawsuit against US gun makers over this exact pipeline was thrown out by the US Supreme Court last year. 🇲🇽 • "criminal organizations in Mexico are well funded, and their tentacles stretch into our communities" • "Firearms trafficking leads to a dangerous path of destruction on both sides of the border"
banner: Arizona gun ring armed cartels: 21 charged

text: ‍BBC: Mexican influencer shot dead during livestream August 5, 2026 | 🟡 📰 BBC covers the killing of César Gastélum — 500k TikTok followers, shot at close range in Culiacán. The explainer: violence "has spiralled since the two factions fell out in September 2024." 🔍 What "fell out" leaves out: the Sinaloa war ignited when El Mayo Zambada was abducted onto a US-bound plane — an operation Mexico is investigating as a violation of its sovereignty. 🇲🇽 • "Violence in the state of Sinaloa... has spiralled since the two factions fell out" • "It is not the first time a social media influencer has been killed in Mexico"
banner: TikToker shot live as Sinaloa war rages

text: ‍REUTERS: Mexico's Sheinbaum weighs pilot fracking projects to boost gas production, sources say August 5, 2026 | 🟡 📰 Reuters lands an exclusive on Pemex's fracking pilots in Coahuila and Tamaulipas — then frames the push to cut dependence on US gas as a Sheinbaum reversal, built on four unnamed sources. 🔍 The number that matters: in June alone, Texas' Eagle Ford shale produced 4.3 billion cubic feet of gas per day — roughly Pemex's entire nationwide output. 🇲🇽 • "Once an opponent of fracking, Sheinbaum has recently changed her position" • one source called US gas dependence "alarming," another saw "no alternative"
banner: Mexico weighs fracking pilots to cut US gas

text:
🇲🇽🏭 <u>MEXICO'S AUTO MARKET: BEST JANUARY–JULY ON RECORD</u>

Mexicans bought 885,349 new vehicles in the first seven months of 2026 — the strongest start to a year since INEGI began tracking in 2005, and 5% above 2025, El Economista reports. July alone moved 130,831 units, the best seventh month since 2016. That is the domestic demand the "Mexico is collapsing" columns keep missing.

🇲🇽🚡 <u>CDMX IS BUILDING THE WORLD'S LONGEST CABLE CAR LINE</u>

Mexico City is adding three Cablebús lines to connect the peripheries the old city never reached. Line 5 — Álvaro Obregón to La Magdalena Contreras, nearly 16 km — will be the longest urban cable car line on the planet, in a system that already moves 50 million passengers a year. Lines 4 and 6 open in late 2027, Line 5 in mid-2028 — and stations in indigenous pueblos like Milpa Alta only after community consultation: "There is no interest in imposing anything on the population," Brugada said.
banner: CDMX: WORLD'S LONGEST CABLE CAR LINE

text:
🇲🇽🗳️ <u>MORENA OPENS ITS 2027 INTERNAL RACE — THE LAST ONE WITH REELECTION</u>

Morena deputies can seek the party's district coordinator posts — and reelection in 2027 — without leaving their seats, party president Ariadna Montiel confirmed: "We allow what the law allows." The context matters: Sheinbaum's reform ending consecutive reelection kicks in with 2030, so 2027 is the last race under the old rules. After that, one term and back to the people.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>"THEY HIT YOU SO YOU WILL PAY THEM" — SHEINBAUM ON MEXICO'S CORPORATE MEDIA</u>

Government advertising is down to a third of what Peña Nieto showered on the big networks, and Mexico's corporate media have found their new business model: "te pego para que me pagues" — I hit you so you will pay me. Her answer: "They are looking for resources they will not get, because the money belongs to the people." López Portillo said he would not pay to be attacked. This government simply does not pay.
banner: MEDIA EXTORTION: 'HIT YOU SO YOU PAY'
